text:
The service was terrible, from the counter to the doctor, who was rude. I think a service center should provide good service. The nurses' service was terrible. Even a foreign patient who couldn't read Thai asked the nurses for help. The nurses didn't help and spoke rudely. The doctor, after examining me, asked why I didn't go to my old place to get dentures. The doctor's examination was sloppy, as if he didn't want to work. It was terrible from the counter to the doctor.
I think the patient paid for the procedure, not just come and ask for it for free. Why is it so bad? If you can't do it properly, then don't come here. You'll be looked down upon from the counter. I'm telling the truth, no exaggeration.
